capabilities: Draw planned and actual time blocks on a day's hour axis
Arrange and resize modules such as todos, habits, notes and time stats
Plan weeks and months with todos, goals and sub-goals
Track recurring rhythms and their weekly progress
Create events from one-line text and show time totals per category
disambiguation: Not a journaling or diary-writing tool; it is a day, week and month planner built around a drawable timeline.
extras: Model features (quick capture, todo review) are optional and the only parts that use the network; needs Obsidian 1.8.7+; built for desktop, mobile layouts not tuned; the plugin ID changed from oneday in 0.1, so upgrading is not in-place.
problem: Daily notes give no way to lay out a day's time visually or to plan weeks and months next to it.
summary: Day, week and month planner with a drawable timeline, movable modules and rhythm tracking, all stored as plain Markdown.
